events.description: Subset of requested, approved, declined, available, failed, issue; empty = all.

seasons.description: TV only; omit for all seasons.

oneOf.description: Feature permissions (default: all on for accounts an admin creates directly).

adaptive.description:
The player switches between variants itself (hls.js): ask for a multi-variant master
playlist, the original plus lazily transcoded rungs (#111). Ignored for casts, IPTV VOD
and when the server's `REEL_ABR` is off.

audio_index.description:
ffprobe stream index of the audio track to use. Omit to let the server choose from the
user's preferences (`GET /me/preferences`).

bandwidth_kbps.description:
Measured throughput (kbit/s) of adaptive players. It picks the start variant and whether
a direct-playable file is direct played; unlike `max_bitrate_kbps` it caps nothing.

for_cast.description:
Receiver is a Chromecast/AirPlay device: defaults the preset to `chromecast` and returns
absolute, 8-hour signed URLs on `cast_base_url`.

item_id.description:
Multi-episode files: the episode being watched (one of the file's `item_ids`); watch
progress is credited to it. Defaults to the file's first item.

max_bitrate_kbps.description: Client bandwidth estimate (kbit/s). The effective cap is `min(this, your bitrate limit)`.

preset.description: Built-in preset: web_chrome (default), web_safari, webos, tizen, android_exoplayer.

oneOf.description: Full device profile. Takes precedence over `preset`.

`auto` (default) | `original` | `1080p` | `720p` | `480p`. Auto keeps the original streams
when they fit the bandwidth cap, else picks the best H.264 ladder rung that does.

start_s.description: Start position in seconds (transcode sessions start there).

subtitle_index.description:
ffprobe stream index of the subtitle track to use. Omit for the automatic choice, `-1`
for no subtitles.

bitrate_kbps.description: Expected bitrate (kbit/s) of the chosen output (source bitrate for direct play/remux).

quality.description: Resolved quality: `original` or a ladder rung (never `auto`).

quality_options.description:
Choices for a quality menu, with expected bitrates and availability (never upscales,
respects the user's bitrate limit).

selected.description: The tracks chosen automatically (or taken from the request) and why.

oneOf.description: The variant the player should start on (prestarted by the server); adaptive sessions only.

variants.description:
Variants of the master playlist (several for an adaptive session, #111; one otherwise;
none for direct play). `decision`, `quality` and `bitrate_kbps` describe the top one.

containers.description: Containers playable directly: mp4, mkv, webm, ts, mov, avi.

library_item_id.description: Library item (movie or show) holding this title, when it is in the library.

oneOf.description: Live download progress when a request is in flight.

vod_movie_id.description: Xtream VOD catalog entry for this title (play it from `/vod/movies/{id}`).

client_state.description: Raw torrent-client state (`metaDL`, `stalledDL`, …); needs a download client configured.

request_id.description: Reel request this belongs to, if any.

speed_bps.description: Needs a torrent client configured (admin → download clients).

"Fetching metadata", "Stalled — no peers", "Queued in client", "Paused").

This source's channels that have a name/id match in this guide, even if an earlier guide

channels.description: Guide channels this import delivered (channels already carried by an earlier guide excluded).

low_power.description: Low-power encoders to use (`-low_power 1`); the regular encoders otherwise.

available.description: Backends that passed a 1-frame test encode, in preference order.

degraded.description: Backends that failed at runtime (ffmpeg exited early) and are no longer used.

permissions.description: Permissions of the account the invite creates.

library_names.description: Names of the libraries the invite grants.

catchup.description: The provider offers catch-up/archive for this channel.

has_epg.description: An EPG mapping exists for this channel.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; absent on the last page.

N100 (#102, #113).

(`REEL_ALLOW_DIRECT_LIVE` and IPTV access).

provider's own guide (when it has one) is imported first, then each of these; for a channel
carried by several guides the earlier one wins. A patch may send masked entries back
unchanged; they keep their saved URL.

query parameters, Xtream `/live/USER/PASS/` path segments). Sending it back unchanged in a
patch keeps the saved URL.

username.description:
Xtream username, masked (`ab••••`, or `••••` when short). Never returned in clear: to change
it, send the new one; sending the masked value back keeps the saved one.

epg_url.description: Deprecated: replaces the list with this single URL (empty string clears).

epg_urls.description:
Replace the external guide URL list (empty list clears). Omit to keep it. Entries may be the
masked URLs from `epg_urls`; they keep their saved URL.

password.description: Omit to keep the current password.

url.description:
New URL. The masked `url` of the source sent back unchanged keeps the saved one; a URL that
still contains `***` is refused. Moving an Xtream source to another server
(scheme/host/port) needs `username` and `password` in the same patch, so the saved login is
never sent to a server the admin didn't type it for.

username.description: Omit (or send the masked value back) to keep the current username; `""` clears it.

channels.description: Channels found (M3U: all; Xtream: live streams).

text.description: Text formats the client can render natively: vtt, srt, ass.

a 10-minute cool-down; software encoding is used meanwhile.

for_cast.description:
Chromecast/AirPlay receiver: defaults the preset to `chromecast` and returns an absolute,
8-hour signed URL on `cast_base_url`.

oneOf.description: `hls` (default), `passthrough` or `direct` (403 unless the server allows it).

preset.description: Built-in device preset (decides which codecs HLS may copy).

takeover.description:
Admins only: if every provider connection is held by other users, stop their streams and
take the slot (answer to a 409 with `takeover: true`).

url.description:
Signed URL: `stream.ts` (passthrough) or `index.m3u8` (HLS). Valid for the configured
signed-URL lifetime; the session itself ends shortly after the player disconnects.
For `direct`: the provider's own URL (contains the provider login; never log it).

api_key.description: Omit to keep the current key.

library_ids.description: Libraries the user may access (ignored for admins, who see everything).

VariantOption.description: One variant of the session's master playlist (#111), in master order (ascending bandwidth).

codecs.description: RFC 6381 `CODECS` value, when every track can be described.

id.description: `original` or a ladder rung: also the variant's URL path segment.

transcode.description: The picture is re-encoded for this variant.

VariantStatus.description: State of one variant for the admin dashboard.

bandwidth_kbps.description: Average bitrate (kbit/s) the master playlist announces.

encoder.description: Video encoder, e.g. `hevc_vaapi (low power)`; `None` when the video is copied.

last_request_s.description: Seconds since the player last requested one of its files.

oneOf.description: File has no usable video stream (audio-only).

codec.description: Normalised codec name: h264, hevc, vp9, av1, mpeg2video …

hdr.description: HDR formats decodable *and displayed* as HDR.

max_level.description: Highest level in ffprobe notation (H.264 4.1 = 41, HEVC 5.1 = 153). `None` = any.

library_item_id.description: The same title in your local library (movie, or show).

for_cast.description:
Chromecast/AirPlay receiver: default preset `chromecast`, absolute 8-hour URLs on
`cast_base_url`.

id.description: VOD movie id or episode id.

max_bitrate_kbps.description: Client bandwidth estimate (kbit/s); the cap is `min(this, your bitrate limit)`.

takeover.description: Admins only: if every provider connection is held by other users, stop their streams.

event.description: Webhook event type as understood by the server (`Grab`, `Download`, …).

scanned_paths.description: Paths that were re-scanned into the library.

bearer.description: Opaque session token from /auth/login. Media endpoints (direct, stream, subs, images) also accept a signed URL (`exp`, `u`, `sig` query).
